        local height = description and description ~= "" and 60 or 48
        local row = baseRow(parent,height)
        local accent = resolveAccent(options.Accent or (options.Danger and "danger" or "cyan"))

        local titleLabel = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, description and 7 or 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-88,0,description and 22 or height),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(title or ""),
            TextColor3 = options.Danger and Theme.Danger or Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 12,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        if description and description ~= "" then
            New("TextLabel", {
                BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,30),
                Size = UDim2.new(1,-88,0,18),
                Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
                Text = tostring(description),
                TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
                TextSize = 9,
                TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
                TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
                ZIndex = 18,
                Parent = row,
            })
        end

        local actionPill = New("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-12,.5,0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(options.PillWidth or 62,28),
            BackgroundColor3 = accent,
            BackgroundTransparency = .88,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })
        Round(actionPill,9)
        Stroke(actionPill,accent,.55,1)

        local actionText = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Size = UDim2.fromScale(1,1),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(options.ButtonText or "RUN"),
            TextColor3 = accent,
            TextSize = 9,
            ZIndex = 19,
            Parent = actionPill,
        })

        local enabled = options.Enabled ~= false
        local awaitingConfirmation = false
        local confirmationSerial = 0
        local item = {}

        local function renderEnabled()
            row.BackgroundTransparency = enabled and .78 or .90
            titleLabel.TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or .48
            actionText.TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or .55
            actionPill.BackgroundTransparency = enabled and .88 or .95
        end

        function item:SetEnabled(value)
            enabled = value ~= false
            renderEnabled()
        end

        function item:IsEnabled()
            return enabled
        end

        function item:SetButtonText(value)
            actionText.Text = tostring(value or "")
        end

        function item:Trigger()
            if not enabled then
                return false
            end

            if options.Confirm then
                if not awaitingConfirmation then
                    awaitingConfirmation = true
                    confirmationSerial += 1
                    local serial = confirmationSerial

                    actionText.Text = options.ConfirmText or "AGAIN"
                    Tween(actionPill,.12,{
                        BackgroundColor3 = options.Danger and Theme.Danger or Theme.Warning
                    })

                    task.delay(options.ConfirmTimeout or 2.2,function()
                        if awaitingConfirmation and confirmationSerial == serial and actionText.Parent then
                            awaitingConfirmation = false
                            actionText.Text = tostring(options.ButtonText or "RUN")
                            Tween(actionPill,.12,{BackgroundColor3=accent})
                        end
                    end)

                    return false
                end

                awaitingConfirmation = false
                confirmationSerial += 1
                actionText.Text = tostring(options.ButtonText or "RUN")
                Tween(actionPill,.12,{BackgroundColor3=accent})
            end

            if callback then
                task.spawn(callback)
            end

            return true
        end

        local hit = Overlay(row,function()
            item:Trigger()
        end)

        hit.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            if enabled then
                Tween(actionPill,.12,{BackgroundTransparency=.72})
            end
        end)

        hit.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            Tween(actionPill,.12,{BackgroundTransparency=enabled and .88 or .95})
        end)

        renderEnabled()
        return item
    end

    function Window:Switch(parent, key, title, description, default, callback, options)
        options = options or {}
        local row = baseRow(parent,60)
        local accent = resolveAccent(options.Accent or "cyan")

        local titleLabel = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,7),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-78,0,22),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(title or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 12,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,29),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-78,0,18),
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = tostring(description or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        local track = New("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-12,.5,0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(44,24),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Track,
            BackgroundTransparency = .20,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })
        Round(track,999)

        local knob = New("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5,.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(0,12,.5,0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18,18),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            ZIndex = 19,
            Parent = track,
        })
        Round(knob,999)

        local state = default == true
        local enabled = options.Enabled ~= false
        local item = {}

        local function render()
            Tween(track,.13,{
                BackgroundColor3 = state and accent or Theme.Track,
                BackgroundTransparency = state and .12 or .20,
            })

            Tween(knob,.13,{
                Position = state
                    and UDim2.new(1,-12,.5,0)
                    or UDim2.new(0,12,.5,0),
                BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.White or Theme.TextDim,
            })

            titleLabel.TextTransparency = enabled and 0 or .50
            row.BackgroundTransparency = enabled and .78 or .90
        end

        function item:Set(value,silent)
            state = value == true
            render()

            if not silent and callback then
                task.spawn(callback,state)
            end
        end

        function item:Get()
            return state
        end

        function item:SetEnabled(value)
            enabled = value ~= false
            render()
        end

        function item:IsEnabled()
            return enabled
        end

        Overlay(row,function()
            if enabled then
                item:Set(not state,false)
            end
        end)

        item:Set(state,true)
        Window.Items[key] = item
        return item
    end

    function Window:Select(parent, key, title, description, values, default, callback, options)
        options = options or {}
        values = copyArray(values)

        local closedHeight = 62
        local row = baseRow(parent,closedHeight)
        row.ClipsDescendants = true

        local accent = resolveAccent(options.Accent or "cyan")
        local value = default or values[1]
        local open = false
        local enabled = options.Enabled ~= false
        local item = {}

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,7),
            Size = UDim2.new(.46,-18,0,20),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(title or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.Text,
            TextSize = 11,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12,28),
            Size = UDim2.new(.46,-18,0,18),
            Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
            Text = tostring(description or ""),
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextDim,
            TextSize = 9,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })

        local selector = New("Frame", {
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,0),
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-12,0,12),
            Size = UDim2.new(.50,0,0,36),
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel3,
            BackgroundTransparency = .47,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            ZIndex = 18,
            Parent = row,
        })
        Round(selector,9)
        local selectorStroke = Stroke(selector,Theme.StrokeSoft,.72,1)

        local valueLabel = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(11,0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-38,1,0),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
            Text = tostring(value or options.Placeholder or "Select"),
            TextColor3 = accent,
            TextSize = 10,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            ZIndex = 19,
            Parent = selector,
        })

        local arrow = New("TextLabel", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1,.5),
            Position = UDim2.new(1,-8,.5,0),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(22,22),
            Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
            Text = "v",
            TextColor3 = Theme.TextSoft,
            TextSize = 10,
            ZIndex = 19,
            Parent = selector,
        })

        local optionsHolder = New("Frame", {
            BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel2,
            BackgroundTransparency = .20,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,closedHeight + 2),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-20,0,0),
            Visible = false,
            ClipsDescendants = true,
            ZIndex = 22,
            Parent = row,
        })
        Round(optionsHolder,10)
        Stroke(optionsHolder,accent,.68,1)

        local list = New("ScrollingFrame", {
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6,6),
            Size = UDim2.new(1,-12,1,-12),
            CanvasSize = UDim2.new(),
            AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
            ScrollBarThickness = 2,
            ScrollBarImageColor3 = accent,
            ZIndex = 23,
            Parent = optionsHolder,
        })

        New("UIListLayout", {
            Padding = UDim.new(0,4),
            SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
            Parent = list,
        })

        local optionRows = {}
        item._Selector = selector
        item._Menu = optionsHolder

        local function refreshVisuals()
            valueLabel.Text = tostring(value or options.Placeholder or "Select")

            for optionValue, data in pairs(optionRows) do
                local selected = tostring(value) == tostring(optionValue)
                data.Row.BackgroundTransparency = selected and .52 or .86
                data.Left.BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0 or 1
                data.Label.TextColor3 = selected and Theme.Text or Theme.TextSoft
            end
        end

        local function buildOptions()
            for _, child in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("TextButton") then
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end
            table.clear(optionRows)

            for index, optionValue in ipairs(values) do
                local option = New("TextButton", {
                    AutoButtonColor = false,
                    BackgroundColor3 = Theme.Panel3,
                    BackgroundTransparency = .86,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Text = "",
                    Size = UDim2.new(1,-3,0,30),
                    LayoutOrder = index,
                    ZIndex = 24,
                    Parent = list,
                })
                Round(option,8)

                local left = New("Frame", {
                    BackgroundColor3 = accent,
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    BorderSizePixel = 0,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0,5),
                    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2,20),
                    ZIndex = 25,
                    Parent = option,
                })
                Round(left,999)

                local label = New("TextLabel", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    Position = UDim2.fromOffset(10,0),
